messages:
jordan: Customer just hit a 400 on /v1/invoke with a JSON schema error. They say it worked yesterday. Escalating.

maria: Can you paste the request payload + the raw error from the gateway?

jordan: Pasting anonymized payload and error below. SDK v2.3.1, region eu-west-1.

```json
{
  "fn": "charge_customer",
  "args": {
    "customer_id": "cust_12345",
    "amount": 1999,
    "items": [
      {"sku": "S-1", "qty": 1}
    ],
    "debug_meta": null
  },
  "session": null
}
```

Error: 400 Bad Request - request.body: additionalProperties ("debug_meta") not allowed at /args

sam: Hm, the schema for that function explicitly forbids additionalProperties on args. Why is debug_meta present as null instead of being omitted? Could be client shim.

jordan: Customer says they upgraded from SDK 2.2 -> 2.3 this morning and started seeing these. They didn't add debug_meta intentionally.

maria: Do we have a repro with the official SDK? Can we reproduce with a minimal curl?

jordan: I tried curl with same JSON but removing debug_meta and it succeeds. With debug_meta: null it fails consistently.

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"fn":"charge_customer","args":{"customer_id":"cust_12345","amount":1999,"items":[{"sku":"S-1","qty":1}],"debug_meta":null},"session":null}'
```

eng-bot: validation-service:rejects_additional_props at 2026-03-17T10:12:13Z path=/args prop=debug_meta rule=additionalProperties

lee: We recently tightened the Function Schema validation in 2.3 to treat explicit null extra keys as present (previously some clients omitted null keys on serialization). That makes sense for stricter schema but breaks compatibility.

maria: Is debug_meta expected to be allowed? I don't see it in the function spec. If not, we should either coerce away null extra props server-side or update SDK serialization. Which is the least risky fix?

sam: Two options: 1) Make validation tolerant for additionalProperties when value is null (quick server-side shim) 2) Patch SDK to strip unknown keys (breaking for customers who rely on sending arbitrary keys). For a customer-facing quick fix, I lean to server-side shim that treats additionalProperties=null as absent for now.

jordan: Customer needs a workaround now. Can we add an env flag to validation-service to accept null additional props for 48 hours while we roll a proper patch?

lee: I can push a feature flag in validation-service: ALLOW_NULL_ADDITIONAL_PROPS. Will default off. Flip on for that tenant. It requires a short rollout but low-risk.

maria: Please also capture the exact SDK call stack and sample serialized body from the customer's logs so we can confirm source of null.

jordan: Got it, requesting logs from customer.

sam: Also check if any other function schemas use additionalProperties=false. We should run a quick audit and alert ProdSec in case this affects multi-tenant rules.

eng-bot: rollout-request created (#3581) by lee - target: validation-service - flag: ALLOW_NULL_ADDITIONAL_PROPS - scope: tenant=cust_12345 - expires: 48h

maria: Great. After we flip the flag, confirm the customer can retry. Also create a postmortem spike: decide whether stricter validation remains default or we revert to previous lax behavior.

jordan: Customer confirmed after flag flip they retried and the call succeeded. They reported no other regressions. :thumbsup:

maria: Action items: 1) lee: short flag rollout (done) 2) sam: audit function schemas for additionalProperties=false (ETA 24h) 3) eng-ml / devex: decide SDK serialization policy (ETA 72h) 4) support: notify customer of temporary fix and planned follow-up.

lee: I'll open PR with the flag and small integration test ensuring null-extra-props are ignored when flag=true.

jordan: Closing this thread once support confirms customer updated/ok. Thanks everyone.
